name: Pricing table
summary: Side-by-side plan comparison with price, billing period, feature list and one CTA per plan. Highlights a recommended plan without hiding the others.

anatomy.purpose: One column per plan: name, price, period, CTA, feature list.
Marks one plan as popular/best value. Never the only signal; pair with text.
Amount, currency and billing period ('$24 / month, billed annually').
Checkmarked included features; dash or muted text for excluded.
One button per plan, consistent placement.
Monthly/annual switch that updates prices without reload.

contentLimits.features: max 8 per plan; longer lists move to a comparison page

variants.name: Two tiers
variants.use: Free vs paid, or personal vs team.

variants.name: Full comparison
variants.use: Long feature matrix for enterprise evaluation.

whenToUse: Upgrading prompts where the current plan is highlighted.
whenNotToUse: A single fixed price: use a simple CTA section.
Usage-based pricing with no tiers: use a calculator or estimator.
More than 4 plans: use a full comparison page with a filter.

accessibility.role: table (comparison variant) or list of regions labelled by plan name; CTAs are buttons/links
keyboard: Billing toggle is a switch or segmented control, fully keyboard operable.
CTAs are in a logical tab order left-to-right, plan by plan.
Recommended badge is text, reachable and announced in the plan's accessible name.
accessibility.focus: Visible 2px focus outline on toggle and CTAs; focused plan card may gain a border, but color is not the only focus signal.
notes: Feature inclusion must not rely on color or icon alone: use text ('Included' / em dash with sr-only text).
Price and period must be readable at 200% zoom without horizontal scroll on mobile — stack plans vertically.
Checkmark icons need aria-hidden with sr-only text, or visible words.
Body text 4.5:1 on card background; muted exclusion text still meets 4.5:1.
